files.rationale: Kept PR A's full web SharedPreferencesUtil that mirrors the native interface and added PR B's extra members (name, lastActive* ids and the simplified web save/get stubs), retyping B's nonexistent Conversation/Message types to ServerConversation/ServerMessage so the file compiles.
Both sides made the same kIsWeb guards, so the merge takes PR A's body (keeping the TODO comment inside the guard) and adds PR B's platform_imports.dart import.
Unified the two native-side shims into one file that re-exports dart:io (including File, Directory and Platform, which covers A's Platform export) and keeps PR B's platform detection helper getters.

Merged both web mocks into one compiling set: one Platform class with isFuchsia and isWeb; one File class with B's exists/existsSync/deleteSync and Future<File> writers plus A's equality/hashCode and String absolute (dropping B's duplicate path/absolute getters); Directory built on B's FileSystemEntity plus A's absolute; and a full typed_data re-export.
